title: Man jailed after sending more than 100 ‘menacing’ messages to Labour MP
summary: Lee White sent a series of abusive emails to Dr Rosena Allin-Khan before later threatening to kill the prime minister A man who threatened to kill the prime minister and sent a flurry of “menacing” messages to a Labour MP has been jailed for 23 months. Cambridgeshire police said Lee White sent 109 messages to Dr Rosena Allin-Khan, the MP for Tooting in south London, over a four-day period between 29 August and 1 September 2024. Continue reading...
